description: This file 'stock_balance.py' contains functions related to stock balance management, stock reposting, and updating stock quantities in the ERPNext system. It includes functions for reposting stock, calculating various stock quantities, updating item bins, and handling serial numbers.

methods.name: repost(only_actual=False, allow_negative_stock=False, allow_zero_rate=False, only_bin=False)
methods.description: Main function to trigger reposting of stock for all items and warehouses, optionally handling negative stock settings.

methods.name: repost_stock(item_code, warehouse, allow_zero_rate=False, only_actual=False, only_bin=False, allow_negative_stock=False)
methods.description: Recalculate and update stock quantities for a specific item and warehouse.

methods.name: repost_actual_qty(item_code, warehouse, allow_zero_rate=False, allow_negative_stock=False)
methods.description: Create stock valuation entries for actual quantities to facilitate stock reconciliation.

methods.name: get_balance_qty_from_sle(item_code, warehouse)
methods.description: Retrieve the latest actual quantity of an item in a warehouse from the stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_reserved_qty(item_code, warehouse)
methods.description: Calculate the reserved quantity of an item in a warehouse based on sales orders and packed items.

methods.name: get_indented_qty(item_code, warehouse)
methods.description: Calculate the inward stock quantities requested but not yet received or delivered.

methods.name: get_ordered_qty(item_code, warehouse)
methods.description: Calculate the total quantity of an item ordered via purchase orders.

methods.name: get_planned_qty(item_code, warehouse)
methods.description: Calculate the planned production or work order quantities for an item.

methods.name: update_bin_qty(item_code, warehouse, qty_dict=None)
methods.description: Update the stock quantities in the bin record for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: set_stock_balance_as_per_serial_no(item_code=None, posting_date=None, posting_time=None, fiscal_year=None)
methods.description: Update stock balances for items with serial numbers based on serial number data and stock ledger entries.

methods.name: reset_serial_no_status_and_warehouse(serial_nos=None)
methods.description: Reset the status and warehouse info for serial numbers with pending documentation.
